label: site test
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: Reached the payment step. Stopped there: nothing was paid.

findings.problem: [name] banner and a 20 percent off newsletter popup both opened on load; the second popup appeared only after the first was dismissed and left a Get 20% Off teaser button that grabbed focus.
Hero and carousel regions repeat long auto-rotating-carousel instructions, and the menu has unnamed links and buttons next to Shop, so the page is noisy and unclear to listen to.

Pressing Enter on Add to Cart gave no spoken confirmation and the cart stayed empty; the cart dialog said 0 items. Only Space added the item, after which the cart opened. I could not tell the first press had failed.
The seven color swatches are all announced as radio [name] Product, with the real color only in a nearby image, so I could not tell which color each choice was or which was selected.

The Pay now button is disabled with no spoken reason, and Express checkout offers three unlabeled iframes plus a card-fields area where Card number, Expiry and Security code are announced only as plain text, not as labeled inputs.
